question: total building footprint area m2 Lisbon
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) AS total_area_sqm FROM lisbon_buildings

question: total footway length km Lisbon
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000.0 AS total_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway'

question: top 5 largest buildings footprint area m2 geojson
sql: SELECT id, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) AS area_sqm, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geometry FROM lisbon_buildings ORDER BY area_sqm DESC LIMIT 5

question: average residential road segment length m
sql: SELECT AVG(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) AS avg_length_m FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential'

question: count buildings footprint >5000 m2
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS building_count FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) > 5000

question: apartments total footprint area m2 metric CRS
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true))) AS total_area_sqm FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE class = 'apartments'
